content_fields.title: Verify that mount propagation mode is not set to 'shared' (Docker)
content_fields.description: Express mounts in long form and pin propagation to a non-shared mode.
content_fields.finding: The bind mount is declared in short-string form, so propagation mode is neither stated nor constrained.
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
  web:
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ./deploy/nginx.conf
        target: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
        read_only: true
        bind:
          propagation: rprivate
criteria: Every bind mount is declared in long form with an explicit propagation value.
`docker compose config` shows no shared propagation.
